تغتصبوا (form VIII)
# تَغْتَصِبُوا (taḡtaṣibū) /taɣ.ta.sˤi.buː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِغْتَصَبَ (iḡtaṣaba)
# تُغْتَصَبُوا (tuḡtaṣabū) /tuɣ.ta.sˤa.buː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِغْتَصَبَ (iḡtaṣaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
